content:
Carlos spends $90 to plant the tree. Each year, he earns 7 lemons × $1.50 = $10.50 from selling lemons, and spends $3 on water and feed. His net annual profit is $10.50 − $3 = $7.50.

After \( n \) years, his total net profit is \( -90 + 7.5n \). He starts earning money when this becomes positive:
\[ -90 + 7.5n > 0 \]
\[ 7.5n > 90 \]
\[ n > 12 \]
So after 12 years he breaks even (net profit = $0), and he first sees a positive net profit after 13 years.

Answer: 13
